learning_objective: 🎯 We will celebrate by measuring threads, identifying patterns, and learning repeated addition!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Look at a Rakhi! It has beads and colors that repeat again and again. Like red bead, blue bead, red bead, blue bead. This is called a pattern!
If you have 3 packets of bindis, and each packet has 4 bindis, you can find the total by adding 4 + 4 + 4. This is repeated addition!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Custom Rakhi
fun_activity.instructions: Use a piece of string and make your own pattern using colorful buttons or beads. Make sure the colors repeat in a beautiful way!

quick_recap: ⭐ Patterns are shapes, colors, or numbers that repeat in a rule.
⭐ Adding the same number multiple times helps us find total quantities quickly.
